$comment: The repo register: which folder on THIS machine each VibeAssist project lives in.
Copy this file to ~/.claude/vibeassist-repos.json and fill in the paths.
Get the ids and names from list_projects. The id is the key — names are not unique.
checkout = the folder the app is served from (the one pinned to main), not a worktree.
A project with no entry is not guessed at: the listener asks you once and writes it here.
